text: Replicate Running 4 times, then erase white ovals, and give stars a golden color.
Are there any cycles? Is the most recent square a hexagon?
Hmm, let me think. Hook Bug42, Ticket9 and Testing to each other! From now on hexagons should be normal. Rename the scarlet hexagon as Cedar!
Switch places of Striker and the indigo star. It was getting crowded. Make a copy of Wr2, then undo. After that, duplicate the amber star twice. Summarize the diagram?
Tuck Dough downwards. Then clone this one 3 times! Perfect.
Sketch me ten stars "sales 2026". Then shrink them, and after that enlarge them.
We are planning the next sprint. Sever the connection from Armed to Error! Open2 is a dot. Is there an amber square? Arrange the ellipses in a ring.
Scale the lime diamonds. After that, add a dotted line from Algae to Kelp. After that, space Squid, Algae and Crab out evenly horizontal. Which hexagon is furthest to Seal?
Hmm, let me think. Build a gold star on the right side. Show me the rules? Is there a cycle?

My manager asked for this. Redo the last change. Also, label all of the ellipses 'notify', and push every turquoise ball along the right edge. Reposition the oldest rhombus on the left of the ellipse.
Turn all the diamonds that are not white regular, and connect Squid to Krill. After that, separate Crab and Fish, and then scoot the ellipses between Shark and Algae!
This is for tomorrow's review. Change the blue rhombus to a circle. After that, inscribe "OK" on that one.
I'm explaining this to my team later. Bring Pivot in front, and after that shrink it. What are the neighbors of Winger? Put Wr1 and Guard on the right side! List the rects that are not gray?
Does R1 lead to Vcc? Make a copy of the first scarlet star. It was getting crowded. What is the nearest golden hexagon from R1?
Make an edge from Uplink to Wan. Describe the hexagon? Who has the most connections?
Label all of the orange diamonds as Q1, and join Fish to Heron, Seal and Squid. Also, link Plankton and Kelp to Shark. Right, that's better. Where can I go from Shark?
Create a triangle name it Plume between Search and Avatar, link Plume to Card, and then undo twice.
I'm explaining this to my team later. Title Yeast "payment". Right, that's better. Remove the line between Sugar and Batter!
Is Swamp downstream of the fuchsia square? Village is minuscule! List all arrows?
Hook Orbit and Sun to Atom. Sorry, long day. Draw a tiny rhombus, name it Mango.
Ok so I'm sketching our office network. Exchange Village with Harbor. Then spawn a medium dot called Wisp under Bridge. Almost done.
What is the shape of Recruiting? Send this one to the back!
Create a turquoise rectangle at the center! What is next to Deployed? Wire Testing, Task7 and Todo in order.
Turn all shapes into a small magenta oval, and drag the ellipses in the center of the page. Then turn the brown ones big!

Label the turquoise block "Is it valid?", then link the same one to Avatar! Just tidying things up a bit. Are any hexagons between Card and Header? Align Navbar, Avatar and Search in a column! What size is the grey ellipse?
Write "Output" on every triangle. Next, shove the first diamond between Harbor and Castle. Perfect.
Are there circles on the top? Add the text "phase A" to the square.
Which shapes can be reached from Deployed? Join Task7 and Ticket9 to Testing with a line!
Trash the black rectangle. Draw a dotted arrow from Scene1 to Chapter4. By default, rectangles are normal and brown.
Link Fuse to Vcc, and Vcc to Motor. Is the Ground bigger than Battery? Bring this one to the front! Almost done.
Fill all the amber ones with green! In the future, new shapes should be fuchsia.
Make a small diamond between Office and Cellar, and then place Kitchen & Cellar beside Porch!
Move the first diamond to the left. After that, connect it to Twist. Villain is aqua.
Parse above Etl! Make this one gray. Ugh, messy. Make it a bit smaller!
Spawn a rose ellipse at the bottom. Next, bring the newest one to the front! Any rects? How many arrows does the Neptune have? Clone Orbit two times.
Scoot the hexagons between Yeast and Eggs. What does the green ball say?
Rb should be in the bottom right. Copy the last magenta hexagon twice, and then lay out Safety, Qb and Keeper in a grid.
I'm drawing the family tree for grandma. Transform all shapes into a ball, make 5 copies of Battery, and then create a red connection between Motor and R1! Thanks!
What's the smallest one? Swamp is in the upper right.
Show me the rightmost shape? Tuck Risks to the right, and then turn navy boxes indigo.
Undo! That way it is easier to read. New diamonds should be teal. Because the old one was wrong. Call the silver hexagon Glacier. After that, color all the fuchsia ones lime!
What has the fewest links? Move Studio 30 pixels up. Also, redo the last change. What is between Attic and Studio? Shove the earliest hexagon to the left.
How many indigo hexagons on the left? Which scarlet squares are by Scope?
Write "Is it valid?" in every violet star. That's the main flow. Connect Draft to Stop2, and Stop2 to Reject! Is there a loop? Make all of the triangles a gray oval, then arrange them in a line.
My manager asked for this. How many connections does the star have? What's the largest one? What is the shape of the rectangle? Are there any orange diamonds?
Which shapes are not cyan? Exchange Cfo and Sales, and slap a gold oval.
This is for tomorrow's review. Attach Decide and Done, tuck Begin left, and then recolor triangles navy.
Place a black dot "retry". After that, hook the black dot to Prologue. Which shape is furthest to the teal triangle?
My manager asked for this. Nuke black ovals! What is downstream from the cyan diamond? What's the highest one? Change all hexagons to violet. Next, shift them upwards.
Shift Venus & Cell right 120 units. Next, reset all the boxes. After that, call Moon Zed. Perfect.
Hook Icing, Sugar, Milk and Cream to the next one. It was getting crowded. Resize Flour and Batter! Icing is between Batter and Salt. Tidy up all the blue hexagons.
Can Batter reach Bowl? From now on all shapes are tiny. Almost done. Drag Salt between Yeast and Batter.
Recolor all the rectangles that are not blue fuchsia, and then arrange the boxes horizontally, and undo. Then put a small star.
Spawn 3 little ellipses between Export and Etl. Paint lime squares scarlet. Also, make every silver rhombus twice as big. Next, bring the blue triangle forward. Sink is a star.
This is for tomorrow's review. Describe the canvas? Is Noah attached to Dad? Swap Grandma and Liam. Almost done.
Plonk a box between Open2 and Closed and shift the box downwards. Then send Closed backwards. That way it is easier to read. Is it rose?
Change the violet ones to big. Make all the shapes normal.
Hook Banner up to the ellipse, and after that turn stars average.
Which rect is nearest to the diamond? Axe everything.

I'm drawing the family tree for grandma. Describe everything? Push the Support left side of Legal, and then bring the same one to the front. Also, write "Shipped" on it. After that, hook that one to Ops.
What is on the canvas? Sever Capacitor from Relay! Perfect.

We are planning the next sprint. Make a silver rect with the text "retry" at the left. Right, that's better. Shift the latest one 50 px up, then morph every rhombus that is not lime into a rectangle, and then turn all ovals which are not green into a lime oval. What is the position of alice?
note: The input has alice in lowercase, which is the keep word; the names list has Alice. Left as written.

text: Intern is giant. Is it grey?
Erase all ellipses which are not brown, and then spread Sales and Lead out vertical.
Ok so I'm sketching our office network. In future, ovals are large and yellow. Make every star large!
Is Customs joined to the triangle? Attach Supplier to Customs and Dock, and then move Retailer downwards. Thanks.
Let me see. Is Running on the left of Armed? Do the arrows form a loop?
Ok so I'm sketching our office network. Delete the default rules. New stars must be medium.
Hmm, let me think. Is Billing on top of Kafka? Do that again. Nice.
This is for tomorrow's review. Cache to Auth! Does Billing flow to Worker? Is there a connection between Worker and Billing? Cut Cdn and Ingress, and Lambda and Billing switch places.
note: The last request is ambiguous in the source (Cut Cdn and Ingress and Lambda and Billing); the comma is the only change.

text: Give all the shapes a golden color. Sorry, long day. Change all the lime ones to a medium triangle. How many connections does sprint1 have? Describe everything? Forget all rules.
Convert all the orange ones into a rhombus. Also, plonk an indigo rect named Flint. After that, write "payment" on the indigo rect. Then clone it 2 times.

My manager asked for this. Hook Vcc up to Battery both ways. Turn every item that is not purple into a triangle. Also, lay out each yellow diamond in a stack, and after that put 4 hexagons beneath Led. Almost done. Move them between Vcc and Relay. Thanks!
Resize Sensor and Diode, and connect Relay and Motor. Which shape is nearest to the cyan square?
Turn the triangles into a box and then send Open2 to the back.
Throw a brown hexagon between Vpn and Uplink called Birch, and tie Nas to Lan and Switch1. Do the arrows form a loop?
Throw a circle. It was getting crowded. Tie Alice to Emma and Bob with a white line labeled "fail"! Just tidying things up a bit. Is Grandma in the upper left? Summarize the diagram?
Does the diagram have any cycles? Which is the bottommost? Which shape has the most links?
Sink and Validate trade places. That way it is easier to read. Change everything to huge. Are there any brown hexagons?
Axe the objects that are not orange. Make the stars that are not black an amber hexagon. Because the old one was wrong. Remove the square!
My manager asked for this. Wire Milk to the navy hexagon. Almost done. Revert. Tuck Mix between Dough and Cream.
Recolor all the shapes lime. Is the latest square massive?
Tag the latest orange hexagon "beta". Is that one blue?
Create a magenta triangle name it Kiwi on the bottom. It should read better now. What color is the latest one? Clone it 2 times. How many arrows are there?
Does the lilac triangle flow to Cfo? Which node is the biggest?
Link Bucket to Auth. Next, sketch a small blue box called Flint, and drag the blue hexagon by 15 to the right. Make the same one bigger.
Get rid of brown ellipses. What rules are there?
Plonk one indigo diamond named Iris in the bottom right corner, and bring Iris to the front.

I'm drawing the family tree for grandma. Shrink all of the gold squares. Then reposition the latest rose circle upwards. Change the shape of the elements that are not black to a square, and rename the brown star to Beacon.
Detach Booting from Paused. Stopped and Armed switch places, and after that link Closed and Locked to Halted. Then remove the default rules!
Pop 2 green ellipses. Then align them horizontally. Ugh, messy. Stick a dot name it Plume.
We are planning the next sprint. Reposition Ground and Battery to the lower-right. Make an enormous rect called Nook. What color is Nook?
Put another triangle name it Juno. Next, unhook Village from Castle.
Tie Mine and Dungeon to Temple, and then turn every triangle that is not navy into a small teal dot!
Build one hexagon with the name Flint between Retry and Approve! What color is the hexagon? Send the same one to the back. Trash purple stars! Reject is golden.
This is for tomorrow's review. List everything next to Enrich? Give the black ones the colour fuchsia. How small is Monitor?
We are planning the next sprint. How many neighbours does the white star have? Build an indigo dot and then paint the indigo dot black. Also, make Vcc way bigger.
Let me see. Align the white triangles in a column! Is the latest square between Db and Kafka? What color is it? What is the color of the star?
Organise the magenta triangles in a ring! Which one is the most connected? Stick a gold diamond with the name Nectar at the top-right. That's the main flow. Space all the shapes in a column evenly!
Duplicate Castle 2 times. Enlarge Dungeon, and move it left of Bridge. Almost done. Sever Bridge and Shrine.
